questions.q: What happens if you call `.query()` and then immediately call `gr.getValue('number')`, without ever calling `.next()`?
options: The cursor isn't positioned on any row yet, so this won't correctly read the first result

questions.explain: Right after .query(), the cursor isn't on a row yet — .next() has to be called at least once to move onto the first result.

questions.q: What is the real difference between `gr.getValue('short_description')` and `gr.short_description`?
options: getValue() always returns a plain string; dot notation returns a GlideElement object that stringifies to the display value

getValue() is deprecated and no longer works in current ServiceNow versions
questions.explain: Both are real and commonly used; dot notation returns a GlideElement, which carries extra methods but behaves like a string in string contexts.
